purpose: Continuously compare public ridertec.org content against canonical internal HR/compliance/system facts without copying credentials or sensitive rider/applicant data into durable knowledge.
surfaces: localized language variants of the same surfaces
downloadable public HR/recruiting/compliance PDFs and forms

checks.compare: public named EEO/HR contacts vs effective-dated internal role registry
checks.alert_on: superseded person still presented as current

checks.compare: public openings/pay/application paths vs current Applicant Dashboard/ATS/openings source
checks.alert_on: stale pay, demo jobs, missing/broken application path, obsolete PDF/email workflow

checks.compare: public job-board benefit eligibility text vs current handbook and current plan/plan-booklet source
checks.alert_on: website states a specific eligibility rule not supported by current governing source

checks.compare: homepage/about/public-notice county/service-area claims vs canonical operations/grant/service-area registry
public Required Documents/Title VI/ADA/EEO resources vs canonical approved plan/form manifest
checks.alert_on: superseded revision/effective date, stale role/contact, missing current replacement
password, PIN, token, access code, embedded authenticated URL or similar secret candidate
checks.persistence_rule: Never store or log the candidate value. Store only source URL/path, finding class, detected-at time, a one-way fingerprint computed locally if needed for dedup, and remediation status.

checks.compare: public instructions requesting SSN/Medicaid/payment-card/medical identifiers vs approved intake/channel/retention policy
checks.alert_on: public copy requests sensitive data without current documented secure handling process

checks.compare: marketing age/year statements against organization founding/service dates
checks.alert_on: obviously stale relative-age copy such as 'celebrating N years' that no longer matches current year

checks.compare: public jobs/bids/content against RTEC entity/service context
checks.alert_on: unrelated template/demo records on production pages

evidence_model.secret_redaction: Before persistence, strip credential-like values and access-bearing URL parameters.

cadence_candidate: daily while public-site cleanup is active, then weekly after parity is stable
notification_policy: Notify on new high-severity security/compliance drift.
Notify when a previously reported problem is confirmed fixed.
Do not repeatedly notify unchanged stale copy every run.
Group related locale drift into one issue rather than one alert per language.
remediation_workflow: close only when public/cached current surface validates
